ops.body:
yasyf-home repair, mid-pass blocker: cc-pool account store has a **schema fingerprint mismatch** (on-disk 01af1e6d…; 0.63.2 wanted fbde893a…, 0.64.8 wants 0efa0acc…) — fails `cc-pool doctor`/`sync status` before any service work. ~/.cc-pool/ carries an interrupted swarm-era migration: pool-v1.db (mtime = the daemon's final "daemon stopped" minute, Jul 22 04:42) beside pool.db (9.5MB, Jul 21), plus cutover-stage-v0.63.2.*/frozen-*/readiness-hotfix-*/accounts.stale-* debris dirs. No migrate subcommand in the CLI.

Disposition: cc-pool leg PARKED on home (option 4) — binary upgraded to v0.64.8, daemon left down; the rest of the repair proceeds (synckitd 0.36.2 in place, cc-notes/reposync upgrades + manifest regen + restarts + 30-min window). **No purge/re-init without the user** — pool.db is live OAuth credential data. A source-level diagnosis lane is reading the fingerprint/migration code on cc-pool main + swarm-era cc-notes records to determine the safe path; verdict lands here. Box lane warned to `cc-pool doctor` before its `sync enable` step (same debris pattern likely).
